notes.note: Bolton was electric in the third term with 40 of his points coming then. He had 23 disposals and a couple of goals.
Just the one goal for Bolton but because he used the footy well at 95% for his 20 disposals saw him stay up in a decent scoring position.
Bolton had the second most CBAs for the game for the Dockers as he had 26 disposals but didn't hit the scoreboard. He can be up and down so just be careful selecting him.
18 touches for Bolton at 72%. This is now three under 90 in the last four for him.
Bolton didn't hit the scoreboard but didn't need to with 27 disposals and 7 marks in the big win.
Bolton didn't get in on the goal scoring and registered 21 disposals and whilst it was his best in the last three it wasn't up where we would have hoped in a Docker win.

Just one goal for Bolton (which was outstanding) to go with 25 disposals at 60%. He hasn't been able to consistently deliver 90+ scores this season with this his lowest in the last five and second in the 70s in a row.
Bolton did kick 2 goals but the conditions didn't help him as it was a scrappy game at times and not free flowing as he likes it. A good result given his 54% efficiency.

Bolton was quiet for three quarters with less than 20 points in each term but like the Dockers he came to life in the last quarter with 47 points. After two big scores this wasn't a bad one but it is a concern that he needed a big quarter to get him there.
Bolton has again had back to back scores over 130 with his 30 disposals. Whilst he has four over 130 he also has three under 70 and that is what we get from him. Feast or Famine.
Bolton can be feast or famine. He has been under 70 in his previous two but this week put up 33 disposals 8 tackles and a couple of goals as he matched his season high.
Bolton backed up his good score with his 33 disposals and interestingly this didn't include any goals. He had 71% CBAs for the second week in a row.
This was the best we have seen from Bolton as a Docker for a while. Just 2 goals but 32 disposals and an equal game high 9 clearances.
